name: Zaseki Panel
description: A calm, single-column landing theme for Zaseki Panel, a small maker of matte lobby wall panels that show which desks are free in shared offices and coworking spaces. The home page opens on three equal columns (a lobby photograph, a solid clay panel with a tilted russet desk grid and the one pre-order button, and a second photograph) with an information bar, then the floor story, three numbered rows, a parallax photo band, a coloured tile directory, an install table, a grey price band, dated lists, question rows and a closing russet band with wide diagonal stripes. Outfit and Nunito Sans, a cool white ground, russet lines and flat sage, clay and sand tiles. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours.

fonts.role: display: headings, wordmark, section labels, numbers (variable 100-900, Latin subset)
text: body, menu, buttons, table cells, forms (variable 200-1000, Latin subset)

summary.en: A one-product hardware landing page: three-column photo and solid panel hero, tilted desk grid, coloured tile directory, price table and a striped closing band.
